about: Differences a pull request MEANS to make to what the bidding engine sends or decides. Each entry: workflow, check, optional node pattern, field pattern (* matches anything), and a reason in words. An entry excuses differences only in the change that adds it; once on main it is carried over and excuses nothing, and once the live worker runs the commit that added it, every pull request fails until it is deleted. A new entry that matches no difference fails the gate. See README.md, Reading a red.

entries.reason: Issue 2543: a live buyer_select attempt row now records the hash of the exact body it posted. A new field on the step row only; the request, the route and the decision are unchanged.

Issue 2543: a lead outside the live share now records the hash of the body it would be sent, so the parity report compares the node with tripoint_ping on the same lead again. Nothing is sent and the lead routes canary_out as before.
